entries.zh: 病例报告在用药史中列出了一种抗焦虑药。

entries.en: The training diagram labeled the tubes connected to the heart-lung machine.
entries.zh: 培训示意图标注了与心肺机相连的管路。

entries.en: The storm brought down a telegraph line beside the railway.
entries.zh: 暴风雨刮倒了铁路旁的一条电报线路。

entries.en: The supply aircraft circled above the marked drop zone.
entries.zh: 补给飞机在标出的空投落区上方盘旋。

entries.en: The instructor checked each static line before the practice jump.
entries.zh: 教练在练习跳伞前检查了每根强制开伞拉绳。

entries.en: Only two ticket machines were in operation that morning.
entries.zh: 那天上午只有两台售票机在运转。

entries.en: The neighbors will have words if the late-night drilling continues.
entries.zh: 如果深夜钻孔继续下去，邻居们就会争吵起来。

entries.en: The student identified the aorist in the ancient Greek passage.
entries.zh: 学生辨认出了古希腊语段落中的不定过去时。

entries.en: The grammar exercise compared aoristic forms with present-tense forms.
entries.zh: 语法练习比较了不定过去时形式和现在时形式。

entries.en: The anatomical diagram highlighted the aortal branches in red.
entries.zh: 解剖示意图用红色突出了主动脉分支。

entries.en: The simulation showed the electric field between two charged plates.
entries.zh: 模拟显示了两块带电平板之间的电场。

entries.en: The publisher's style sheet requires dates to follow the same format.
entries.zh: 出版社的样式表要求日期采用相同的格式。

entries.en: The cleaner emptied the waste-paper basket beside the desk.
entries.zh: 清洁工清空了书桌旁的废纸筐。

entries.en: The bay window gave the reading room a view of the garden.
entries.zh: 凸窗让阅览室里的人能够看到花园。

entries.en: The teacher placed an exam paper face down on each desk.
entries.zh: 老师在每张课桌上放了一份正面朝下的试卷。

entries.en: We chose navy blue for the curtains in the study.
entries.zh: 我们为书房的窗帘选择了藏青色。

entries.en: The pathology archive indexed the specimen under aortitis.
entries.zh: 病理档案将该标本归入主动脉炎类别。

entries.en: The archaeological plan marked the columns of the ruined apadana.
entries.zh: 考古平面图标出了那座已成废墟的古波斯宫殿大厅中的柱子。

entries.en: The charter listed the villages granted as an apanage.
entries.zh: 特许状列出了作为封地授予的村庄。

entries.en: The technician removed a loose cable from the disc drive.
entries.zh: 技术人员从磁盘驱动器上拔下了一根松动的电缆。

entries.en: In the story, bandits lie in wait near the mountain pass.
entries.zh: 故事中，强盗埋伏在山口附近等待袭击。

entries.en: The game warden checked permits at the forest entrance.
entries.zh: 狩猎监督官在森林入口检查了许可证。

entries.en: The blade of one figure skate needed sharpening.
entries.zh: 一只花样滑冰鞋的冰刀需要磨利。

entries.en: The management consultant interviewed staff about delays in processing orders.
entries.zh: 管理顾问就订单处理延误问题采访了员工。

entries.en: The pilot reported engine failure shortly after leaving the runway.
entries.zh: 飞行员在离开跑道后不久报告了发动机故障。

entries.en: The committee tried to slough off outdated rules that slowed every decision.
entries.zh: 委员会试图抛弃那些拖慢每项决策的过时规则。

entries.en: The audience listened apathetically as the speaker repeated familiar promises.
entries.zh: 演讲者重复着熟悉的承诺，听众无动于衷地听着。

entries.en: The exhibit explained why the old ape-man reconstruction was scientifically outdated.
entries.zh: 展览解释了为什么那件旧猿人复原模型在科学上已经过时。

entries.en: The fictional creature had long arms and an apelike face.
entries.zh: 这个虚构生物有着长长的手臂和一张像猿猴的脸。

entries.en: The commercial treaty reduced duties on imported machinery.
entries.zh: 这项通商条约降低了进口机械的关税。

entries.en: The claim form requested a receipt for each medical expense.
entries.zh: 索赔表要求为每笔医疗费用提供收据。

entries.en: The student underlined the subordinate clause in the complex sentence.
entries.zh: 学生在这个复杂句的从句下面画了线。

entries.en: A red paper clip held the three invoices together.
entries.zh: 一个红色回纹针把三张发票夹在了一起。

entries.en: The curator noted damage to the rifle's battle sight.
entries.zh: 馆员记录了步枪表尺的损坏情况。

entries.en: The historian compared the labor party's early manifestos with its later programs.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了工党的早期宣言与后来的纲领。

entries.en: Please pay heed to the warning signs near the cliff.
entries.zh: 请注意悬崖附近的警示牌。
